roster.w: Who is on which Working Shift, day by day. A roster row puts an employee — or everybody in a company, branch, department or team — on a shift for a date range and overrides their default shift for those days; the most recent row covering a day wins, so a one-day change is a one-day row.
f: Assign one person or a whole scope
Newest row wins where two overlap
s: Pick the month and filter to the people you are rostering.
Choose who, the Working Shift, From and To; save.
Cancel a row to fall back to the scoped shift.
roster.tip: Attendance reads the roster: the late check and the shift hours for a day come from the rostered shift.
roster.rel: Also see: Working Shifts, Daily Attendance
